title: Payment
description: Payment transaction record for an order. Tracks payment details, transaction ID, amount, payment method, status, and card information (last 4 digits and brand for card payments).

id.description: Unique identifier for the payment record

transaction_id.description: Unique transaction identifier from the payment processor or gateway

order_id.description: Foreign key reference to the order this payment is for

customer_id.description: Foreign key reference to the customer who made the payment

amount.description: Payment amount charged to the customer

currency.description: ISO currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

method.description: Payment method used (e.g., credit_card, debit_card, paypal, bank_transfer, apple_pay)

status.description: Payment processing status (e.g., pending, processing, completed, failed, refunded)

card_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the credit/debit card used for payment (if applicable)

card_brand.description: Card brand or network (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover) if card payment

created_at.description: Timestamp when the payment was initiated

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the payment was successfully processed and completed
